typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Asset Alias} as string,
		{Date and Time of Answer} as date,
		{Site Alias} as string,
		Answer as double,
		{Record ID} as string,
		Asset_ID__c as string,
		{Asset Classification Short Name} as string,
		{Metric Type} as string,
		{Property Type} as string,
		Capacity as integer,
		{Question Label} as string,
		{Supports IT Load} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AssetClassificationShortName as string,
		MetricType as string,
		PropertyType as string,
		QuestionLabel as string,
		Answer as double,
		ETLUser as string,
		Capacity as integer,
		SiteAlias as string,
		AssetAlias as string,
		SupportsITLoad as string,
		RecordID as string,
		AssetID as string,
		DateandTimeofAnswer as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		AssetClassificationShortName = {Asset Classification Short Name},
		MetricType = {Metric Type},
		PropertyType = {Property Type},
		QuestionLabel = {Question Label},
		Answer,
		ETLUser,
		Capacity,
		SiteAlias = {Site Alias},
		AssetAlias = {Asset Alias},
		SupportsITLoad = {Supports IT Load},
		RecordID = {Record ID},
		AssetID = Asset_ID__c,
		DateandTimeofAnswer = {Date and Time of Answer}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
